input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision in the Agreement. It bars assignment by either party without the other's prior written approval, with a mutual carve-out only for a "financially responsible affiliate". It fails the fallback because there is no successor right at all (no merger/acquisition/asset-sale carve-out, no successor-with-notice construct) and no reasonableness standard on consent; the retained no-consent affiliate exception also cannot coexist with a fallback under which every non-successor assignment requires consent. Rather than strip our own affiliate right to reach fallback, we move to the preferred position: Client-only affiliate and successor assignment without approval, TrueLink assignment only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor. No change-of-control termination right exists today, so the added confirmation is a clarification only.

proposal.summary: Client-side affiliate/successor assignment right; TrueLink assignment only with Client's consent, never to a competitor; no termination on Client change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need freedom to assign to an affiliate or to a successor by merger or asset sale, and TrueLink should not gain a termination right if we undergo a change of control. We have therefore made the consent requirement one-way on TrueLink (subject to a reasonableness standard and a bar on assignments to our competitors) and set out our affiliate/successor rights expressly; a mutual successor-with-notice construct is our fallback.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without Client's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and shall never assign to a Client competitor.

ops.text: Client may assign or transfer this Agreement without approval to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of Client shall give TrueLink any right to terminate this Agreement.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
